segments.text: We first tried Point-of-Sale (POS) in 208. At the time, market pressure mattered because competitors moved online and took some market share.
The biggest issue was Skills gap. Without steady power in Maiduguri, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after Point-of-Sale (POS)—we saw Customer retention within 3 months.
Policy-wise, Regulatory licenses shaped our move. We adjusted by Pilot then scale.
Data helped; even a simple regression model gave us clearer demand patterns during Easter.
